RULE_SOC_MAX_CEILING.name: High SOC Ceiling Cap
RULE_SOC_MAX_CEILING.description: Caps charging target to 80% to mitigate high-voltage electrolyte oxidation and mechanical stress at cathode.

RULE_SOC_MIN_FLOOR.name: Deep Discharge Floor Protection
RULE_SOC_MIN_FLOOR.description: Raises minimum discharge floor to 20% to prevent copper dissolution and transition metal dissolution at low potential.

RULE_CRATE_CEILING.name: Maximum C-rate Kinetic Limit
RULE_CRATE_CEILING.description: Restricts fast charging current to 1.5C to prevent localized lithium plating at anode edges and excess resistive heat.

RULE_THERMAL_LOCKOUT.name: High Ambient Fast-Charge Lockout
RULE_THERMAL_LOCKOUT.description: Refuses DC fast charging when ambient temperature >= 42°C, reverting to slow AC charging (0.3C) to prevent severe thermal acceleration of cell aging.
RULE_THERMAL_LOCKOUT.action: Refuse DCFC, fall back to slow AC rate

RULE_CELL_OVERHEAT_DERATE.name: Dynamic Cell Temperature Derating
RULE_CELL_OVERHEAT_DERATE.description: Iteratively cuts charge rate when predicted cell temperature exceeds 35°C to preserve cell integrity.

RULE_CATASTROPHIC_SHUTDOWN.name: Critical Overheat Charge Abort
RULE_CATASTROPHIC_SHUTDOWN.description: Completely cuts off charging (0.0C) if predicted cell temperature exceeds 50°C and cannot be mitigated.

guidelines:
Battery Preservation Guidelines (from simulation findings):
DISCLAIMER: Guidelines derived from hypothetical degradation comparison and BMS safety enforcement.
- NMC: unrestricted fast charging reaches end-of-life in 2.1 yrs; best strategy 'full_protection' gives 5.6 yrs (+3.5 yrs).
- LFP: unrestricted fast charging reaches end-of-life in 5.6 yrs; best strategy 'full_protection' gives 9.4 yrs (+3.8 yrs).
- Sodium-ion: unrestricted fast charging reaches end-of-life in 3.5 yrs; best strategy 'full_protection' gives 6.2 yrs (+2.7 yrs).
- Solid-State: unrestricted fast charging reaches end-of-life in 8.5 yrs; best strategy 'full_protection' gives 13.2 yrs (+4.7 yrs).
- Keep SOC between 20% and 80% for daily use.
- Avoid DC fast charging when cell temperature would exceed 35C; cap charge rate at 1.5C.
- Pre-condition the pack before fast charging in hot or cold weather.
